message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
    build:
        name: Build
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        steps:
            - name: Checkout
              uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

            - name: Install JDK
              uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
              with:
                  distribution: zulu
                  java-version: 24

            - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6.4.0
              with:
                  validate-wrappers: true

            - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@v4
              with:
                path: ~/.gradle/caches
                key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

            - name: Install Android SDK
              run: ./.github/android-sdk.sh

            - name: Lint check with Ktlint
              run: ./kotlinw scripts/ktlint.main.kts

            - name: Build with Gradle
              run: ./gradlew build buildHealth --stacktrace
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds an Android/Kotlin project with Gradle and already cancels stale runs, but it does not cache Gradle dependencies. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and the measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, 20.4% elapsed savings) support adding a dependency cache for ~/.gradle/caches keyed on Gradle files. This preserves all required checks (Ktlint lint, Gradle build, buildHealth) and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access beyond the standard GitHub Actions cache service.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
